summary: Assess supplier and logistics risks, build a risk register, and plan mitigation actions. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Supply chain risk assessment helps procurement, logistics, continuity, and risk professionals identify vulnerable suppliers and routes and evaluate disruption exposure. This foundation-level course uses supplier mapping, risk registers, risk matrices, and FMEA to assess dependencies, prioritize exposures, and draft proportionate mitigation actions and reports, with AI-assisted monitoring introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level supply chain risk assessment course is designed for professionals who evaluate supplier, logistics, continuity, or sourcing exposure as part of their work.
modules: Supply Chain Mapping and Risk Identification
ISO 28000 and NIST Supply Chain Controls
prerequisites: No formal risk-management qualification is required. Familiarity with basic procurement, logistics, supplier management, or continuity work will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
